description: This file defines a Theme class for managing UI theming in a React project, integrating with Ant Design and Emotion. It includes theme creation, configuration, toggling dark mode, and provider components.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: A class for managing and applying UI themes, supporting configuration, toggling dark mode, and providing theme context in React.

methods.name: fromConfig
methods.description: Creates a Theme instance from a given configuration, optionally merging with a base theme.

methods.name: getFilteredAntdTheme
methods.description: Generates and filters Ant Design tokens to only include allowed tokens for Superset.

methods.name: getAntdTokens
methods.description: Retrieves Ant Design design tokens based on the provided theme configuration.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Updates the theme with a new configuration, recalculating tokens and updating providers.

methods.name: toSerializedConfig
methods.description: Serializes the current theme configuration for storage or transmission.

methods.name: toggleDarkMode
methods.description: Switches the theme between dark and light modes by updating the algorithm in the configuration.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns the current theme configuration as a formatted JSON string.

methods.name: updateProviders
methods.description: Updates React context providers with the current theme, antd config, and emotion cache.

methods.name: SupersetThemeProvider
methods.description: React component that provides theme context to child components, managing theme state.
